zh.name: Word 文档工具箱

abilities.name: PDF Toolkit

zh.name: PDF 工具箱

abilities.name: Remotion Best Practices

zh.name: Remotion 最佳实践

abilities.name: Resume Tailoring

abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 简历定制

abilities.name: Codebase Migration and Refactoring
abilities.description: Run a large migration or multi-file refactor through a tracked pipeline: measure the blast radius, apply AST codemods, open one pull request per batch, gate each batch on CI, and audit the dead config and leftover shims afterwards.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 代码库迁移与重构
zh.description: 把动辄上百个文件的框架升级或重构，按批次推进：一条精确变换规则、AST 改造、每批一个 PR、CI 绿了才继续，最后清掉迁移留下的死配置与临时兼容层。

abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 鹈鹕骑车
zh.description: 活动面板里骑自行车的鹈鹕小游戏。和 AI 对话即可调速度、让它跳跃、按铃铛，或切换白天、黄昏、天黑与下雨场景。

abilities.name: Build Apple Apps

abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 构建 Apple App
zh.description: 把实时的 iOS 模拟器放进活动面板，让 AI 构建、安装、启动并操作你的 App，内置 SwiftUI 开发指南。

abilities.name: Web Element Picker
abilities.description: Open any webpage inside Astravia, click to pick elements, and generate structured context — CSS selectors, XPath, semantic paths, React component chains. Copy instantly or send straight to the AI for code changes.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 网页元素选择器
zh.description: 在 Astravia 内置浏览器中打开任意网页，点选元素并生成结构化上下文——选择器、XPath、语义路径、React 组件链。一键复制或发送给 AI 直接改代码。

abilities.name: dbx Database
abilities.description: Connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, ClickHouse and 100+ databases. Encrypted connection manager, multi-tab SQL editor, sortable result grid, write safety confirmation and query history. Turn any query result into filterable dashboards — 11 chart types, offline single-file export — and let AI read your database through MCP.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: dbx 数据库
zh.description: 直连 PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite、ClickHouse 等 100+ 种数据库。连接管理（密码加密）、多标签 SQL 编辑器、可排序结果表格、写操作安全确认与查询历史；把查询结果做成可筛选的看板与大屏，11 种图表、导出为断网可用的单文件 HTML，并让 AI 通过 MCP 直接读取数据库。

abilities.name: Free Model Gateway

abilities.author: Astravia Community

zh.name: 免费模型网关
zh.description: 运行受管的本地网关，复用上游免费模型通道并同步模型到 Astravia，提供一键启停、日志与风险声明界面。

abilities.name: Open AI Canvas
abilities.description: Run the open-source AI canvas locally and use the image and video models you configured there from the host. Text bridges one way, media models register as a host provider, MCP tools cover projects, canvases and tasks, the canvas's 73 built-in skills are readable from the agent, and the runtime updates itself in place when upstream ships a new build.
abilities.author: Astravia Community

zh.name: Open AI Canvas
zh.description: 在本地运行开源 AI 画布，并让宿主直接使用你在画布里配好的图片与视频模型。文本单向桥接，媒体模型注册为宿主 Provider，附项目/画布/任务管理的 MCP 工具；画布自带的 73 个内置技能也能被智能体直接读取，运行时还能就地升级到上游最新版。

abilities.name: REA Reverse Engineering

abilities.author: Astravia Community

zh.name: rea逆向工程

abilities.name: Video Downloader
abilities.description: Paste a video link and download the highest quality locally — 1000+ sites supported, with progress, a queue and a shortcut to the finished file. The engine sets itself up, so there is nothing to install.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 视频下载器
zh.description: 粘贴视频链接即可在本地下载最高画质，覆盖 1000+ 站点，支持进度、队列与直达文件夹；解析与合并组件会自动准备好，无需手动安装。

abilities.name: Hanshuang Pojia
abilities.description: Audit an APK, iOS package, ELF, PE or Mach-O file from the chat: permissions, exported components, embedded secrets, section entropy, symbol tables, function-level disassembly with a call graph, and a 0-100 risk score — plus 340 bundled field documents, manuals and full case studies the agent can search mid-investigation.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 寒霜破甲
zh.description: 在对话里体检 APK、iOS 包、ELF、PE 或 Mach-O 文件：权限、导出组件、硬编码凭据、节区熵、符号表、区间反汇编与 0-100 风险评分。

abilities.name: ego-browser
abilities.description: Drive websites and browser automation through the ego lite Chromium browser with your own login state, without losing control of your tabs.
abilities.author: Astravia / Citro Labs

zh.name: ego-browser
zh.description: 通过 ego lite 浏览器驱动网页与浏览器自动化，沿用你自己的登录态，且不抢你标签页的控制权。

abilities.name: Kali Linux
abilities.description: Run Kali Linux tooling on this machine without a VM: the skill provisions a per-OS Kali runtime (WSL2 on Windows, the official rolling container on macOS and Linux), drives every command through one audited CLI, and ships 16 scenario playbooks with 270 per-tool references covering recon, web and API testing, Active Directory, passwords, wireless, cloud-native, forensics and reporting. The driver does not classify targets or filter commands; scope and destructive operations are decided in conversation, and every command is logged.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: Kali Linux
zh.description: 不用虚拟机就能在本机跑 Kali 工具：技能按系统自动部署 Kali（Windows 用 WSL2，macOS 与 Linux 用官方滚动容器），每条命令都走同一个带审计的命令行，并自带 16 份场景 playbook 与 270 份单工具参考，覆盖信息收集、Web 与 API 测试、活动目录、口令、无线、云原生、取证与报告。驱动不分类目标、也不过滤命令：范围与破坏性操作在对话中定，每条命令都留痕。

abilities.name: Qiushi Methodology
abilities.description: Ten playbooks for framing, focus, iteration and review, shipped as one skill that picks the one that fits and works offline.
abilities.author: HughYau / Astravia

zh.name: 求是方法论
zh.description: 十份方法论规程：先弄清事实，再判断矛盾、选择主攻、检验方案，让长任务推进有据可依；装一次、用到哪件读哪件。

abilities.name: Mahua Novels
abilities.description: A multi-agent novel studio: a deterministic engine holds the schedule while an architect plans, a writer drafts, an editor judges and an arbiter rules — with a shelf, a reader, a foreshadowing ledger and continuity auditing behind them.
abilities.author: Astravia

zh.name: 麻花小说网
zh.description: 多智能体小说工作室：确定性引擎守住进度，架构师规划、写作者起草、编辑评审、裁定者定夺；底层有书架与阅读器、伏笔台账、可执行的写作规则与一致性审计。
